prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1101; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports being the driver of the vehicle struck on the passenger side. Initial statement taken by phone. Claimant reports left shoulder pain and limited range of motion. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Police report received. Responding officer documented damage consistent with a side impact and noted both drivers stated their light was green. Witness statement not yet obtained. Vehicle inspection scheduled with the appraisal vendor.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted the office to ask about the claim process and the timeline for vehicle repairs. Claimant confirmed they have not retained an attorney and prefers to communicate directly. Explained the rental coverage options and the medical payments benefit. Claimant has not yet seen a physician for the shoulder and is considering an urgent care visit.

Entry 4: Appraisal completed. Damage estimate consistent with side door, quarter panel, and rear wheel assembly replacement. Vehicle declared repairable. Claimant provided medical documentation from urgent care showing a shoulder strain with a recommendation for physical therapy. Reviewed the documentation and requested the treatment plan and any imaging results.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Claimant reports ongoing shoulder pain but says they are attending physical therapy twice weekly. Confirmed the rental vehicle is in place and repair shop assignment is pending. Advised claimant to submit all medical bills and receipts as they come in. Next review set for the coming week once the physical therapy progress report is received.
